name: Big Green Pocket Park

layers.essential_history: [[c:Big Green is a pocket park, and the village board says it was set up in 1997.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The board says Big Green was once part of Warmington's Great Green, one of several commons at the edge of the village that were enclosed around 1800. The pocket park was made in 1997 on derelict land that had once been tried as allotments but was too heavy with clay and too prone to flooding. It's less than a third of an acre. Children from the village school helped create a meadow, a butterfly garden and a bog garden with a pond, and it's now used as an outdoor classroom.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: you find a torn page from an inventory. It lists a blue dispatch chest, last seen being moved to ]]Mr Vale[[c:'s store.]]
